verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs say the data retention period can be customized on all paid plans, so customers can control how long data is kept. Nothing in the evidence documents deleting data, such as removing items or occurrences or account-level purge requests, and retention control is limited to paid plans. Missing for 10: documented data deletion and purge controls, retention control on free plans, detail on retention options, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
